versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00033, SRS_Rte_00110, SRS_Rte_00018 The RTE generator shall reject an input configuration where neither a queueLength attribute of a ServerComSpec nor an RteServerQueueLength is defined for a ClientServerOperation in a PPortPrototype with an RunnableEntity being triggered by an OperationInvokedEvent that references the ClientServerOp- eration .
